info.title: Consent API
info.description:
## Why use the Consent API?

Today, products are more than just UX and apps, they include the ability to enrich
user interactions and data with other 3rd parties. To do this, consent is needed to
ensure that these third parties can ask for and get consent for your data and attributes.

* Create intuitive and easy-to-use consent management process for your users.
* Define your data elements, attributes, and definitions for the types of data to consent to.
* Enable third parties to lookup and verify consent as well as get notified of consent changes.
* Support GDPR and regulatory privacy needs.

## What can you do with the Consent API?

You can use the Places API to include the following features in your applications:

* Provide centralized consent management for your organization.
* Provide consent that can be automated and managed through the organization, projects, apps and experiments.
* Empower your OIDC / OAuth 2 flows to create compelling consent screens.
-----
